notes.description: Our campsite is open all year round and provides the perfect setting for your stay in the Innviertel. You can explore the sights of the city, discover one of the many cycling or hiking trails, or experience culinary highlights.

This typical Mühlviertel four-sided farm was built in 1835 by the then owners Anna & Martin Mascherbauer. Since 2005 we - the Holzweber family - have been managing the Mascherbauerhof in Winden. On our organic farm we also welcome camping guests.
